transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today?

I guess... I just can't keep my mind on one thing lately. I'll be at work, trying to fix a rendering bug, and... I don't know, a Slack ping goes off. Or I notice a color pattern on the screen. Or there's a siren outside. And suddenly I'm just... pulled into a completely different idea. I can't even finish a single line of code before my brain is somewhere else. So, my wife thought I should come in.
Can you recall if this kind of difficulty focusing has been a long-standing issue, maybe even going back to your childhood, or is this something that's more recent?
No, not childhood. It's... more recent. Just about three months, I guess. It started right around the time my platform was selected for the Glendale showcase.
Have you been feeling more restless or hyperactive lately, like you can't sit still or you're always on the go?

Yeah, I guess you could say that. It's... it's like I've been running on this constant current lately. I'll wake up and I'm already planning out new features, or... exhibition layouts. Press angles. Code changes. 

Sitting still just feels like... like I'm wasting the moment, I guess.
Have you noticed your thoughts racing, like they're moving too fast to keep up with, especially when you're feeling that constant current you described?

Yeah, I suppose. When I start explaining the platform... I guess I just keep going. The architecture, funding, cultural impact, the deployment plans. 

People tell me they can't get a word in. But... it's just that the thoughts are arriving too fast to pause.
Have you noticed that you need less sleep lately, like you feel rested even if you haven't slept much?
No, not really. I sleep... a normal amount, I think. Maybe a little less, but... I don't feel like I need less. I just sleep when I sleep.
Have you had any periods in the last few months where you felt down or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy?
No. Not really. I don't... I haven't felt hopeless. I've just been focused on the work, mostly. I don't really lose interest in it.
Have you noticed your mood being unusually high, expansive, or overly confident lately?

I guess... I feel good. Really good, mostly. Like things are finally clicking. I've just felt... lit up, I suppose. Like I'm unstoppable with what I'm building. 

But... I don't know. I get annoyed. People keep trying to slow me down. My wife, the guys at work... they keep talking about "process" and doing things a certain way. And I just... I snap at them. They're just moving too slow.
Have you found yourself starting more projects than usual or pushing yourself to do more things than you typically would, even if others tell you to slow down?

Yeah, I guess. I've been... doing a lot. 

Just, you know, emailing curators, talking to community leaders. I've been rewriting the whole backend of this thing, mocking up installations. Trying to get some other devs on board. 

I'm doing it at night, mostly. Or whenever. It's just... it feels a lot bigger than my regular job right now, so I have to keep pushing.
